bio: Thom Hannum is a percussion arranger, show designer, and drum instructor who won six DCI World Class Championship titles with three drum and bugle corps. He worked with the Cadets, Carolina Crown, Star of Indiana, and Crossmen, and joined the Boston Crusaders as Senior Advisor in 2023. Hannum was on the design team for the Tony Award-winning show Blast! and served as Associate Director of the University of Massachusetts Minuteman Marching Band for 41 years.

Bill Hamilton joined the Bluecoats in 1972 as a soprano horn player and remained with the organization for 48 years. He served as brass instructor, corps director (1993–2003), program coordinator (2004–2005), program director, and corps manager (2006 onward), and was also a DCA brass judge in 1997.

Alex Beltran marched with The Cadets from 2011 to 2014, winning the DCI World Championship in 2011 and the Fred Sanford High Percussion Award as battery section leader in 2013. He served on the battery staff of The Cadets (2015–2016) and joined the Boston Crusaders percussion staff in 2017, later becoming their Battery Caption Manager. Beltran is also the Director and Battery Arranger for United Percussion, a WGI Independent World finalist.

Allen Justus performed as front ensemble section leader for the Bluecoats Drum and Bugle Corps from 2002 to 2004 and was named Percussion Member of the Year in 2004. He served on Bluecoats percussion staff from 2005–2007 and again from 2013, rising to Front Ensemble Coordinator and Assistant Percussion Caption Head, and was part of the 2022 team that earned the Fred Sanford Award for Best Percussion Performance. Justus currently serves as Director of Percussion at Leon High School in Tallahassee, Florida.

Blake Dutton served as Color Guard Designer & Supervisor for Phantom Regiment in 2023. He has worked with programs in the BOA, WGI, and DCI activities including The Cavaliers, as well as serving as a choreographer and designer at Avon and Center Grove High Schools.

Brady Sanders is a designer and choreographer for the Boston Crusaders (2016 onward) who previously performed with The Cavaliers color guard from 2003 to 2007 and served as a choreographer there from 2008 to 2015. During his tenure at The Cavaliers, the corps won DCI World Championships in 2004 and 2006 and received the George Zingali High Color Guard award in 2004 and 2007. Since 2010 he has been a designer and choreographer for the Pride of Cincinnati Winterguard, which won WGI World Championships in 2013 and 2016, and he is the founder and Artistic Director of the Pride of Cincinnati Dance Ensemble.

Dave McGrath served as Program Coordinator for The Cavaliers Drum and Bugle Corps from 2016 to 2019. He is the Program Coordinator on the Design Team and Educational Leadership for Pacific Crest (2026). He has judged at DCI World Championships and served on the DCI Judge Liaison team in 2013.

Jonathan Vanderkolff was born in Kitchener, Ontario, Canada, and graduated with honors in music theory and composition from the New England Conservatory of Music. He took over the visual program for Star of Indiana in 1993 and led the transition from "Brass Theater" to the Tony and Emmy award-winning Broadway production "Blast!" He joined the Bluecoats organization as Artistic Director in 2013 and was inducted into the DCI Hall of Fame.

Lin Daffron is a Dance and Movement instructor on the Visual Staff of the Boston Crusaders, as listed on the corps' official staff page. She has also been referred to as a visual staff member and Movement Specialist for the Boston Crusaders.

Pat Seidling is the System Blue Live Events Manager for the Blue Devils organization. He served as director of the Phantom Regiment from 2001 through 2006 and was assistant director of the Madison Scouts. He also served as director of Southwind Drum and Bugle Corps and received the DCI Dr. Bernard Bagg's Award for Outstanding Leadership in 2003.

Alan Miller is the front ensemble arranger and staff coordinator for The Cavaliers Drum & Bugle Corps, having taught with the corps since 2002 and served as staff coordinator from 2012–2015. He is also Percussion Director at Braswell High School in Denton, Texas, and has arranged for WGI ensembles including Cavaliers Indoor Percussion and Gateway Percussion. Miller studied percussion at West Texas A&M University and was a nine-year member of the Amarillo Symphony Orchestra.

Bill Redd earned his degree in Music Education from Slippery Rock University. He served as Assistant Brass Caption Manager and Director of Crossmen Winds at the Crossmen Drum and Bugle Corps, and has been on the brass instructional staff / High Brass Coordinator at the Santa Clara Vanguard. He has also taught with the Blue Knights Drum and Bugle Corps and currently serves as Director of Bands at Colleyville Heritage High School in Texas.

Bob Medworth has served as a marching technician and caption supervisor for the Star of Indiana, Carolina Crown, the Madison Scouts, and is currently on staff with the Bluecoats. He was also a member of the Brass Theater and Blast! staff. Before his drum corps involvement, he was the band director at Northview High School for 41 years, leading his marching bands to 39 Indiana State Finals appearances and 10 state championships.

Justin Cunha is a designer and educator based in Southern California who serves as Visual Assistant Caption Manager for the Santa Clara Vanguard. He spent eight summers as a performer with the Vanguard organization (four with Vanguard Cadets, four with the A-corps), aging out as drum major in 2012, and has since worked on staff for both groups  including as caption head and choreographer for Vanguard Cadets where he amassed multiple DCI open class titles. He was Visual Co-Coordinator for Shadow Drum and Bugle Corps in 2019 and Drill Designer for The Academy Drum and Bugle Corps in 2024. He also teaches theology at Santa Margarita Catholic High School in Orange County.

Matthew Hernandez served at the Blue Stars Drum and Bugle Corps from 2013 to 2019 as front ensemble manager, caption head, and arranger. He previously performed with the Crossmen, Colts, and Blue Devils drum corps. He is currently Percussion Director at Klein Collins High School and a percussion instructor at multiple Southern California programs. He is an endorsed artist of Vic Firth, Zildjian, and Evans.

Michael McIntosh has been a percussion designer for The Cavaliers since 2009, also serving as Percussion Caption Supervisor and Music Coordinator. He marched with the Concord Blue Devils after being cut from the Cavaliers in 1987, and is a Butler University music graduate. He was a percussion specialist at Carmel High School for 15 years and is an active clinician and Yamaha Artist.

Ray Linkous has nearly 30 years of drum corps experience, marching with the Star of Indiana and serving as a brass instructor for the Crossmen, The Cadets, and Carolina Crown, where he later became Director of Operations and Education. He is currently a consultant and Music Ensemble Specialist with the Santa Clara Vanguard and serves as Director of Bands at Nation Ford High School.

Reid Paxton is the Front Ensemble Coordinator for Phantom Regiment and Percussion Director at James Bowie High School in Austin, Texas. He marched front ensemble with Carolina Crown (2003–2005) and Phantom Regiment (2007–2008), winning the DCI World Championship and Fred Sanford High Percussion Award with Phantom Regiment in 2008. He has taught percussion at Madison Scouts (2009), Phantom Regiment (2010), and Santa Clara Vanguard (2011–2019), earning five additional Fred Sanford awards with Vanguard.

Steve Vento has been an educator in the pageantry arts for over 25 years with over 20 years of drum corps experience. Since 2011 he has been on the Blue Devils brass staff, and beginning Summer 2017 he became the brass arranger for Legends drum and bugle corps. He holds a B.S. in Education from Missouri Western State University and a Masters of Music Education from the University of Tulsa, and has composed over 50 original compositions and arranged over 450 shows for marching band and drum corps.

Tom Gasparrini is a battery instructor for the Bluecoats Drum and Bugle Corps and Rhythm X. He performed as a snare drummer with the Connecticut Hurricanes, The Cadets, and as center snare of the Bluecoats. He has also performed with United Percussion and Rhythm X, and serves as percussion director at Bellbrook High School.

Willie Veenstra is the Visual Caption Coordinator for the Bluecoats, a position he has held since 2020. He marched with the Bluecoats from 2011 to 2015, playing trumpet and serving as head drum major. He also works as a marching arts instructor, designer, and Calculus AP teacher at Bridgeland High School in Texas.

Abraham Garcia earned his Bachelor of Instrumental Music Education at Arizona State University and resides in Chandler, Arizona. He performed three years with The Academy Drum and Bugle Corps and served as a visual educator with the Sacramento Mandarins (2012–2013). He was a visual instructor with The Arizona Academy Drum and Bugle Corps (2014–2019) and is a visual instructor with Pacific Crest.

Andy Filipiak is a composer, arranger, and music educator focused on the marching arts. He served as Front Ensemble Coordinator for the Boston Crusaders (2012–2019) and as Front Ensemble Arranger for the Mandarins (2020–2024). He is currently Front Ensemble arranger and Coordinator for Monarch Independent. His marching career includes the Glassmen, Matrix, Cavaliers, and Rhythm X, and he was part of the Cavaliers' 2011 Fred Sanford High Percussion Award.

Brian Dinkel is a percussion educator, composer, and sound designer who has been on the staff of the Blue Devils Drum & Bugle Corps since 2009, currently serving as Front Ensemble/Audio Caption Head and Front Ensemble Arranger/Sound Designer. He has also taught and designed for highly decorated programs in Southern California, including at Riverside City College since 2004, where he is Front Ensemble Caption Head and Designer for the RCC Marching Tigers and RCC Indoor Percussion.

Chris Allen marched with the Cadets of Bergen County and served as brass technician and brass caption head for the Glassmen (1997–2003). He was brass caption head for the Boston Crusaders in 2005, worked with the Bluecoats (2012–2013), served as Brass Ensemble Consultant for the Blue Stars (2014–2018), and returned to The Cadets brass faculty (2021–2023).

Mark Eichenberger holds a DMA in Percussion Performance from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign and is a freelance percussionist and educator based in Lawrence, New Jersey. He has been Front Ensemble Arranger and Percussion Coordinator for The Academy Drum and Bugle Corps since 2013 and serves as Front Ensemble Consultant for the Colts. He also works with percussion programs at Hunterdon Central and Hopewell Valley High School and maintains a private lesson studio in the Princeton area.

K.J. Stafford is the Assistant Percussion Caption Head for the Santa Clara Vanguard, a role he has held since 2011, and he joined the Madison Scouts design team as Music Supervisor in 2024. He previously served on the percussion staff of the Phantom Regiment and the Troopers. Stafford is also the band director at Hickory Middle School in Chesapeake, Virginia, and holds a Bachelor's in Music Education from the University of North Texas and a Master's in Secondary Education from Old Dominion University.
